paper_title: PromptMind Team at EHRSQL-2024 Improving Reliability of SQL Generation   using Ensemble LLMs
caption: Individual vs Ensemble Models
model_annotation: This line plot compares the reliability scores of three different models—labeled "3-Model Ensemble" (blue line with circular markers), "2-Model Ensemble" (red line with circular markers), and "GPT-4" (yellow line with circular markers)—as a function of cost, which is plotted on the x-axis ranging from 0 to 10 with tick marks at integer intervals. The y-axis represents the "Reliability Score," scaled linearly from 30 to 90 with major gridlines at 30, 50, 70, and 90. At a cost of 0, the reliability scores are approximately 85 for the 3-Model Ensemble, 87 for the 2-Model Ensemble, and 89 for GPT-4. As cost increases, all three models show a decline in reliability score. The GPT-4 model exhibits the steepest decline, falling from 89 to approximately 40 by a cost of 10. The 2-Model Ensemble and 3-Model Ensemble lines are relatively close to each other, both decreasing from around 87 and 85 respectively at cost 0 to approximately 72 and 74 respectively at cost 10, with the 2-Model Ensemble line remaining slightly above the 3-Model Ensemble line across the entire cost range.
